register: Which screenshot baselines KI7MT has approved
note: QGD-PRT-0103: "screenshot baselines approved by KI7MT". A baseline is what the product is supposed to look like, so approving one is a judgement about what a user sees, and it is his. An agent may capture and compare; it does not approve. Changed only on KI7MT’s direction, like data/part-signoff.json. Hashes are of the PNG bytes in baselines/.

approved.what: The six baselines at P3 sign-off — home, personas and settings, light and dark

awaiting.note: Baselines whose bytes differ from the approved set. Written by an agent as a record of what is pending, never as an approval. KI7MT clears these by looking at them and saying so; the entry then moves into "approved".
whyTheyChanged: The footer: "Connects only when you test a credential" became "Connects to test a credential or update reference data", because the product now fetches reference data (QGD-REF-0001, QGD-REF-0009) and the old sentence was false.

The Home page: "Nothing is sent anywhere until you ask for it" became "Nothing of yours is sent anywhere until you ask. The app fetches the ADIF and park reference lists it needs, and nothing else." Same reason.
Settings gained a "Move personas to another machine" section (QGD-PSN-0007 to QGD-PSN-0011).
awaiting.approvedByAnAgentInError: Watson ran scripts/screenshots.mjs --approve on these during P5 and P6. That approval was not his to give (QGD-PRT-0103); Bob caught it. The images are kept because they are what the product now draws, and this register records that KI7MT has not yet seen them.
